tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Paper is snow white, and Night is the cab at 3 AM.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and anything holding content, on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers and route columns, behind `surface` cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines separating panels and rows. Decorative only, so it needs no contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and controls. Holds 3:1 against `surface`.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Sidebar, conditions band and storm command strip. The same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on `night`.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `night`.

tokens.name: block-deep
tokens.usage: Large dark shapes in brand graphics. Lifts in Night so it stays visible.

tokens.name: beacon
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen, and live progress. Never as text on `ground` in Paper.

tokens.name: beacon-press
tokens.usage: Hover and press state of `beacon`.

tokens.name: on-beacon
tokens.usage: Text on `beacon`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on `ground` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: A selected state on the driver screen, with black text. Not a brand color.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Finished, paid, as text or badge. Always with a word.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: The driver Done button and full progress, with black text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look, as text on `ground` and `surface`. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or late, as text on `ground` and `surface`. Always with a word.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, such as Close storm, with white text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on `ground` and `surface`. Solid, and at least 3:1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between driver buttons, and between list cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding and sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and progress bars, like a sign plate.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Driver buttons and cards.
